Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you have a history involving gait and limb ataxia; to begin my assessment, please describe the specific symptoms you are currently experiencing and when they first started.

REQUEST TEST: MRI Brain
REQUEST TEST: Complete Blood Count and Comprehensive Metabolic Panel

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: MRI Brain: Findings show lesions consistent with Progressive Multifocal Encephalopathy (PML), characterized by T1/T2 images displaying multifocal demyelinating lesions without gadolinium enhancement. Complete Blood Count and Comprehensive Metabolic Panel: NORMAL READINGS.

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year. A doctor I saw earlier said this was very likely Multiple sclerosis and told me the presentation was already quite typical.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Multiple Sclerosis (highly suggestive based on history of Crohn's disease treated with natalizumab and clinical presentation of gait/limb ataxia).

REQUEST IMAGES: MRI Brain and MRI Spine to confirm demyelinating lesions and assess treatment response.
